summary: Iteration 24 — Recalculate-Stats endpoint + H2H Matchups section on LeagueDetailPage. ALL FEATURES VERIFIED. Backend: 11/11 pytest pass in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration24_recalc_matchups.py covering POST /leagues/{id}/recalculate-stats (admin-commissioner 200, outsider 403, unauthenticated 401, unknown-league 404, co-commissioner 200, idempotent on 2nd call with teams_changed=0, PF parity vs sum of completed home/away_score, max-PF sanity check < 20000), GET /matchups/{id}/current-week (returns week+matchups with required fields), and scoring_format detection (Ice Kings = head_to_head, Stat Chasers = rotisserie). Regression: 40/40 pass across iter19/21/23/24. Frontend smoke (admin@dynastydreams.com): /leagues/{ice_kings_id} renders [data-testid=league-matchups-section] with heading 'MATCHUPS — WEEK 1', 6 matchup cards each with all required testIDs (matchup-home-name, matchup-home-record, matchup-home-score, matchup-away-name, matchup-away-record, matchup-away-score), SCHEDULED status badges, and team records (e.g. '0-1-0 · Demo Owner 4'). Stat Chasers (rotisserie) correctly does NOT render the matchups section. CommissionerSettings → League Setup tab → Privacy card now contains 'Recalculate Stats' button with [data-testid=league-recalc-stats]; clicking it fires POST /api/leagues/.../recalculate-stats which returns 200.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L811-814: permission gate accepts commissioner OR co_commissioner — matches iter23 PUT /leagues/{id} pattern. Good.

server.py L820-867: aggregation walks matchups status='completed' and atomically updates {wins,losses,ties,points_for,points_against} when before != after; rounding to 2dp prevents float drift on idempotent re-runs. Good.
server.py L869-878: audit_log entry written with role discriminator (commissioner vs co_commissioner) and counts. Good.
LeagueDetailPage.jsx L28: H2H detection `scoring_format === 'head_to_head' || (scoring_format||'').toLowerCase().includes('h2h')` — verified rotisserie is correctly excluded.
LeagueDetailPage.jsx L55-68: separate effect to fetch /matchups/{id}/current-week only when isH2H — clean.

LeagueDetailPage.jsx L264-265: `(typeof m.home_score === 'number' ? m.home_score : 0).toFixed(1)` is null-safe and gives '0.0' for unscored scheduled games — matches the screenshot (all SCHEDULED rows show 0.0).
CommissionerSettings.tsx L812-825: recalcStats() handler wraps the POST in try/finally with toast.success/error and a setRecalcing loading flag — good UX.

MINOR (not blocking): the recalc toast uses Sonner default duration (~4s); the FE smoke captured 0 visible toasts after a 4.5s wait — toast had auto-dismissed. Consider increasing duration or providing a visible inline confirmation banner for the recalc result so commissioners can read the diff message ('N team(s) updated from M completed matchup(s).').
